name: Do I need to own the property to build an ADU?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to own the property to build an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, ADUs/JADUs require property ownership or legal control; they cannot be built speculatively without a primary residence on the lot.

description: Yes, ADUs/JADUs require property ownership or legal control; they cannot be built speculatively without a primary residence on the lot.
